docs.title: About
docs.text:
Senior Technical Writer with 30+ years of experience creating clear, accurate documentation across multiple fields—application security (AppSec), networking, IoT, healthcare, banking software, compliance, and industrial machinery.

I specialize in translating complex technical ideas into effective documentation that serves end users, engineers, executives, auditors, and customers. My technical expertise includes DITA, docs-as-code (Git, GitHub, GitLab), OpenAPI/Swagger-based REST API documentation, Oxygen XML Editor, FrameMaker, InDesign, single-source publishing, and translation workflow management. I also use a variety of AI tools—including ChatGPT, Claude Code, Gemini, Rovo, and Microsoft Copilot—to improve efficiency while maintaining technical accuracy.

In addition to full-time roles, I've run an independent technical writing business (Clark Professional Writing Services), providing technical documentation for SaaS companies, healthcare organizations, and enterprise technology clients.

I’ve owned the end-to-end documentation lifecycle (Packsize, Financial Fusion), implemented authoring tools, managed projects, supervised and mentored writers (Black Duck, Compliatric, Financial Fusion, Ameritech), and led the migration to structured DITA authoring (GE Healthcare).

I'm interested in senior technical writing or documentation leadership opportunities where I can help engineering organizations deliver exceptional API, developer, compliance, and customer documentation for application security, SaaS, and enterprise software products.

docs.title: Professional Summary
docs.text: Senior Technical Writer with over 30 years of experience creating clear, accurate, and effective documentation for technology-driven organizations. Skilled at learning complex products quickly and translating highly technical concepts into clear, easy-to-understand content that helps users, customers, engineers, executives, and business stakeholders achieve their goals. Experience spans application security (AppSec), networking, IoT, medical software, banking software, library systems, and industrial machinery.

docs.title: Core Competencies
docs.text:
• Documentation Tools & Standards: DITA (Adobe FrameMaker, Oxygen XML Editor), MadCap Flare, RoboHelp, HTML/XML/CSS/Markdown, REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger
  • Knowledge Management & Collaboration: Confluence, Git, GitHub, GitLab, Jira
  • Editors & IDEs: Eclipse, Visual Studio Code
  • I/CD & Build Tools: Jenkins
  • AI-Assisted Writing Tools: ChatGPT, Claude Code, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Rovo
  • Process & Methodology: Agile/Scrum, Documentation Lifecycle, Docs-as-Code
  • Productivity & Capture: Microsoft 365, Snagit, Adobe Suite

docs.title: Professional Experience
docs.text:
Senior Technical Writer / Lead Writer, Black Duck (formerly Synopsys)...2022–2026 Led a team of writers in creating technical documentation for Coverity. Created user, installation, and administrator guides for other AppSec products, including Bridge, Seeker, Sigma, and Software Risk Manager. Wrote and reviewed release notes. Collaborated with engineers, QA, product managers, and other writers in an Agile environment. Created structured documentation using DITA. Authored and maintained REST API documentation generated from OpenAPI/Swagger specifications. Authored and maintained documentation using a docs-as-code workflow with Git, GitHub, and GitLab for version control, collaboration, and review. Managed documentation localization and translation workflows.

Senior Technical Writer, Packsize...2020–2022 Created a broad range of technical documentation, including user manuals, installation and calibration guides, maintenance manuals, SOPs, and ECNs. Partnered with QA and HR to define company procedures and standards. Established the foundation for a scalable documentation team by creating a house style guide, designing templates, improving information architecture, training writers, and implementing production processes.

Senior Technical Writer (Owner), Clark Professional Writing Services...2018–2020 Authored a wide range of technical documentation for a variety of tech companies. Produced training and user documentation for SaaS products. Authored regulatory and compliance documentation. Worked with clients to standardize methodologies, tools, processes, and documentation style guidelines. Designed new templates for print and online documentation and created SEO-optimized marketing content for company websites. Partnered with PR professionals and clients to create press releases, thought leadership articles, bylines, website content, and executive biographies. Notable client work included user documentation for Compliatric, a healthcare compliance SaaS platform.

Technical Writer, Panasonic Salt Lake City Laboratory...2012–2018 Authored user guides, white papers, training materials, tutorials, positioning papers, technical overviews, case studies, and customer success stories. Maintained content for the company website, which included authoring blog posts and articles about IoT technologies. Implemented structured authoring using DITA. Created department style guides, glossaries, and template designs.

Lead Technical Writer, Boart Longyear...2010–2012 Led a team of writers and product managers in creating technical documentation for mining equipment. Managed projects and writing resources across offices in the U.S., UK, Canada, Australia, and India. Defined document templates, style conventions, and production processes. Oversaw quality control, document libraries, translation services, budgets, training, and hiring.

Senior Technical Writer, GE Healthcare...2009–2010 Authored user manuals, installation guides, and online help for GE Healthcare software products. Developed and implemented a department style guide, including the creation of structured and unstructured FrameMaker templates. Led the migration to DITA.

Technical Writer (Senior Associate), Novell, Inc....2003–2008 Created a variety of user documentation, including online help, methodology documents, marketing collateral, white papers, and content for the corporate website.

Senior Technical Writer / Team Lead, Financial Fusion, Inc....1999–2003 Led a team of eight writers in creating product user guides, online help, and tutorials for banking software. Managed documentation projects, implemented documentation processes, administered documentation and project management tools, and hired new writers. Owned the end-to-end documentation lifecycle.

Senior Editor, Marketing, Ameritech Library Services...1995–1998 Managed a team of editors, writers, and graphic designers in producing a variety of marketing collateral. Authored feature articles, ad copy, press releases, company policy documents, executive speeches, and content for other company publications. Edited all customer-facing documentation. Set department style and formatting standards.

Earlier Career...1991–1995 - Technical Communications Specialist, Dynix — Authored user manuals and reference documentation, partnered with engineers during development, and delivered on-site training. - Technical Writer, Unisys Corp. — Created user manuals and contributed to product planning and release schedules. - Computer Technician, Salt Lake Community College Library — Configured library computers, assisted with IT system maintenance tasks, and trained staff on library software applications.
